description.p: Keeping family records, school files, invoices, and administrative paperwork organised is a constant challenge, especially when documents come in from many different countries and institutions.

Mantener registros familiares, archivos escolares, facturas y documentación administrativa organizados es un desafío constante, especialmente cuando los documentos provienen de muchos países e instituciones diferentes.

MiAZ solves this with a simple, consistent file-naming convention of seven fields: date, country, group, sender, purpose, concept, and recipient. Scan a letter, download an email attachment, drop it into your MiAZ repository, and the app guides you through naming it correctly.

MiAZ resuelve esto con una convención de nombres de archivos simple y consistente de siete campos: fecha, país, grupo, remitente, propósito, concepto y destinatario. Escanea una carta, descarga un archivo adjunto de correo electrónico, suéltalo en tu repositorio MiAZ y la aplicación te guía para nombrarlo correctamente.

ul.li: Multiple independent document repositories
Múltiples repositorios de documentos independientes
No database. The directory is the database
Sin base de datos. El directorio es la base de datos
Fast workspace that handles thousands of documents
Área de trabajo rápida que gestiona miles de documentos
Powerful sidebar with filters for every field
Barra lateral potente con filtros para cada campo
Single and mass renaming of documents
Renombrado masivo de documento(s)
Project management: group related documents into named projects
Gestión de proyectos: agrupar documentos relacionados en proyectos denominados
Plugin system for extending functionality
Sistema de plugins para extender la funcionalidad

description.p: An AppImage that runs anywhere, background work you can watch instead of guess at, a keyboard shortcut for every action, and a faster start.

ul.li: The AppImage carries its own Python, GTK, libadwaita, libpeas and WebKit, so it runs on distributions that ship none of them. It also knows how to update itself
Background work has a place in the header bar: what is running, how far it has got, and what failed. A job that failed used to disappear without saying anything
A large import says which document it is on and how many are left, and its bar no longer reaches the end with work still to do
Long imports and ZIP exports no longer make the desktop offer to close the window
Two imports can no longer copy into the same repository at the same time

Every core action has a keyboard shortcut, and the ones that used to take a combination the desktop or a text entry already owns have been moved. The shortcuts window is built from the same table the keys come from, so the two cannot drift apart
A repository can be marked as remote, per machine, so MiAZ stops treating a mounted drive as if it were a local folder
MiAZ starts faster: it no longer does a quarter of its startup work for a window nobody opened, nor the rest of it twice
The document list scrolls better: a preview already rendered is not decoded again, and a document's date is not read out of the file every time something asks for it
A maximized window comes back maximized, instead of as the size of the screen
Stepping back over a configuration change keeps the redo
A crash while MiAZ is starting now shows the crash dialog, instead of crashing the crash handler
A row no longer keeps the style of an inactive document after that document has scrolled past

description.p: Disabling a plugin now really disables it, the right-click menu is no longer cut off behind a scrollbar, and MiAZ starts even when libpeas and pygobject are out of step.

ul.li: Switching a plugin off takes its keyboard shortcuts with it. Ctrl+P went on running MiAZProjectMgt's assign action after the plugin was disabled, against a service that was already gone
The plugin info button works again. It showed nothing at all for seventeen of the twenty bundled plugins
A plugin installed from a ZIP file can be enabled straight away instead of after a restart, the file is checked before anything is unpacked, and a plugin that cannot be enabled says why
Submenus in the right-click menu open at their own size, instead of being squeezed into the height of the menu they came from
The "document scanned and imported" toast no longer repeats forever, and neither do the three OCR ones
The workspace shows the Copy column only when a document on screen really does have a twin
Notes sit under Documents, then Annotation, beside the OCR action that saves what it extracts as a note
MiAZ starts even when libpeas and python3-gobject are built against different versions, and says which two to update
Installing no longer fails because of a stale icon cache

description.p: A command line that does what the window does, four new ways to read the same documents, notes and a repository doctor built in, and undo for the whole repository.

ul.li: miaz is a real command line: add, delete, rename, search, read notes and run OCR, on a machine with no desktop toolkit installed; a plugin can add commands of its own
Four new ways to look at the same documents: a Grid of pages, a Timeline, Conversations between the two parties of a document, and the Filenames as they are on disk
The first page of the selected document, in the workspace and in the rename dialog, so a filename that says nothing can be settled without opening the file
Notes are part of MiAZ rather than a plugin. They moved into the repository's own .conf/notes folder, and a repository written by an older MiAZ moves them itself when it opens

MiAZDoctor checks a repository in one pass: names that break the convention, values nobody uses, documents with the same content, files that went missing. It can run when the repository opens, and every finding puts the documents it names on screen

MiAZContacts reads the senders and recipients as contacts, each with an address, a phone number and an IBAN. The contact manager imports and exports them as vCard files, so they can leave as easily as they arrived
MiAZHistory: undo and redo for the whole repository, with a history of what changed
MiAZRelated: the documents around the one you are reading
Documents can be dragged out of MiAZ into another application
The window fits a phone
Repository Settings is three tabs instead of six, and a plugin is configured in it rather than in a dialog of its own
What acts on the documents is on a toolbar above them, along with the views, Review and a menu to choose the columns
An empty repository can be filled again: the empty page has its own Add button, with an entry per enabled import plugin
miaz search --from and --to work at last, and a repository written by a newer MiAZ is refused instead of opened

description.p: Runs on Debian 13, marks duplicate documents in review mode, gathers every field suggestion under one menu, and speaks complete Spanish again.

ul.li: The keyboard shortcuts window no longer needs libadwaita 1.8, so MiAZ runs on Debian 13; the startup check now compares toolkit versions correctly against the real floors, GTK 4.10 and libadwaita 1.7
Review mode marks a document whose content matches another one; the column sorts copies next to each other and the tooltip names the twin and says whether it is filed already
One Suggest menu in the rename dialog covers everything that proposes filename values, in sections that say what is read locally and what is sent to an AI
The rename dialog says what it is doing while it reads a document, and its pages are a menu instead of a row of tabs that widened with every plugin
The date in the rename dialog is checked when you leave the field or press Rename, not on every keystroke, and a half-typed date is no longer completed into a date nobody chose
Adding documents from a directory and copying document names are core features now, not plugins, and an import of more than twenty files runs in the background
Backup and restore run behind a progress dialog that reports each file, instead of freezing the window
The setup assistant asks about countries and nothing else; groups, purposes, senders and recipients start with every shipped value enabled
A name containing an ampersand no longer blanks list columns and dialog messages
The plugin menus are flatter and the plugin catalogue uses six one-word categories
The deb and the rpm declare ocrmypdf and the Python venv tooling, so OCR and the external libraries work on a clean install
Running miaz with no display says so and points at the command line, and a crash leaves a Python traceback in the log instead of a core dump
Spanish is complete again, all 1011 strings; the never-translated German and French catalogues are gone

description.p: A command line that works without a display, repository switching without a restart, and dates read from the document instead of guessed.

ul.li: New command line: miaz search finds documents in any repository and miaz repos lists them, so searching works over SSH and in scripts
Switch repository without restarting the application, and choose separately whether it becomes the default
The filing date is read from the document itself: PDF creation date, XMP, image EXIF and Office metadata, with no extra libraries needed
A date that cannot be read is filed as 99991231 and sorts to the end, instead of being silently filed under today
Ambiguous dates such as 03/04/2024 are refused rather than guessed, and document metadata is trusted over digits in a filename
The rename dialog has a button to read the date again on demand
Plugins unload completely and start clean, which fixes a crash on right click after disabling a plugin
The projects file can no longer be emptied when the app and the workspace disagree about which repository is open
Faster, quieter startup: the plugin directories are scanned once instead of twice, and the browser page no longer reloads once per plugin
First automated interface test suite, plus a manual checklist used as the release gate

description.p: Groundwork release: the workspace filter, the document index and the configuration each became a thing of their own, and both packages are now verified before release.

ul.li: The document parse moved into a new index, so it exists once instead of twice and can be tested without a display
The workspace filter became a value that can be saved, restored and compared, which is what saved searches will need
Each repository owns its configuration, so switching no longer reads settings left behind by the previous one
Background work runs through one helper that reports its failures, instead of eight hand-rolled threads that swallowed them
A failed background operation no longer freezes the workspace for the rest of the session
Plugins can contribute sidebar and header bar widgets through helpers that clean up after themselves on unload
The rename dialog refuses to apply a name that is not valid, and gained a Manage projects button
The .deb and the .rpm are built from one export of one commit and checked against distribution policy before release
Fixed the "Since last year" date filter, which covered the wrong period

description.p: Secrets in the system keyring, a localized interface, a faster workspace, and a rename dialog plugins can extend.

ul.li: AI provider API keys are stored in the system keyring instead of plain text
Country, Group and Purpose labels are shown in your language; French and German catalogues added
Plugins can add tabs to the rename dialog: set a project or a periodicity while renaming
Rename dialog is keyboard-friendly: typeable date, Ctrl+Enter to apply, Esc to cancel, invalid names refused
Faster workspace on large repositories: single file changes update one row, and scans no longer touch the disk per row
New MiAZInsights plugin page: all-years overview, period selector, activity heatmap, rank movers and a world map
One AI plugin: MiAZAIChat merged into MiAZAIAssistant, so providers are configured once
Adding documents is always available: it moved from an optional plugin into the app
Optional third-party libraries install into a private virtualenv, never into the system Python
Failed plugins are reported in the app instead of only the log, and every plugin now has an icon
Config files are written atomically, so a crash cannot leave a half-written repository
Fixed date filters that hid documents at month boundaries and past midnight
Flatpak packaging is deprecated: a sandboxed build cannot reach host tools such as ocrmypdf and scanimage

description.p: AI chat, mass rename as a core feature, a per-repository change journal, and several new plugins.

ul.li: New plugin MiAZAIChat: chat about a document via Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama
Mass rename is now a core feature with a guided Concept transform dialog
Per-repository change journal records every add, rename, and delete with import provenance
New plugins: MiAZNewspaper, MiAZYearReport, MiAZOCR, MiAZFullscreen, MiAZColumnVisibility
MiAZNotes renders the note body as Markdown in view mode
Embedded localhost web server with a built-in Browser page
Global crash handling with a log file and an error dialog
Rename: filenames forced to uppercase, and Suggest metadata from documents sharing the concept
Sidebar filters: case-insensitive substring search with sorted entries

description.p: AI-assisted renaming, document notes, column visibility, and rename dialog improvements.

ul.li: New plugin MiAZAIAssistant: propose all seven filename fields via Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama
New plugin MiAZNotes: attach Markdown notes to any document with faceted filtering and backup/restore
New plugin MiAZColumnVisibility: toggle workspace column visibility
Rename dialog: inline Add buttons on restricted-vocabulary rows
Rename dialog: Concept autocomplete via difflib-backed popover
Workspace: Adw.InlineViewSwitcher for workspace view switching
Backend: filename_guess_date() probes PDF metadata, EXIF, and file mtime

description.p: Sidebar redesign, unified plugin system, performance improvements and startup fixes.

ul.li: Sidebar rebuilt with Adw.Sidebar (icon-only filter rows and resizable pane)
Plugin system unified: no more system/user distinction
Plugin sidebar filters now show the plugin icon
Review button turns red when pending documents exist
Eliminated spurious workspace updates on startup
Dropdowns now show "Any country", "Any group", etc.
